subject.title: feat(feishu): native Markdown for inbound content_v2 & outbound tag:md

question: Should Feishu native tag:md replace the shipped auto-card and tableMode behavior for existing installations, or remain an explicitly selected delivery mode?
rationale: The branch intentionally changes existing carrier-selection and configuration semantics, so the permanent upgrade policy requires maintainer intent rather than an implementation-only judgment.

options.title: Preserve Compatibility
options.body: Keep auto-card routing and tableMode conversion, introducing native tag:md only through an existing explicit mode or a narrowly approved opt-in.

options.title: Migrate The Default
options.body: Make tag:md the new default only with explicit upgrade documentation, configuration treatment, and proof covering streaming on and off.

options.title: Split Inbound Work
options.body: Land content_v2 ingestion separately while deferring the outbound carrier-policy decision.

recommendation.title: Preserve Compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep auto-card routing and tableMode conversion, introducing native tag:md only through an existing explicit mode or a narrowly approved opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged render-mode work established the primary outbound behavior and configuration contract being reconsidered.
